hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: Warm up with $\tan 135^\circ$: the reference angle $45^\circ$ sets the size at $1$, and Quadrant II makes tangent negative, so $-1$. Size first, then sign.
$315^\circ$ is in Quadrant IV. Is tangent positive or negative there?
Only cosine is positive in Quadrant IV, so tangent is negative: $\tan 315^\circ = -1$.

explanation: $315^\circ$ lies in Quadrant IV with reference angle $360^\circ - 315^\circ = 45^\circ$.
In Quadrant IV, $x > 0$ and $y < 0$, so $\tan\theta = \frac{y}{x}$ is negative: $\tan 315^\circ = -1$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Straight from the coordinates
steps: The identical magnitudes cancel and only the minus sign survives: $-1$.

alternativeExplanations.title: ⚠️ The trap here
steps: The trap answer is $+1$ — you found the reference angle correctly, got $\tan 45^\circ = 1$, and then forgot the sign step.
Make it a two-part habit: reference angle gives the SIZE, quadrant gives the SIGN. Quadrant IV keeps only cosine positive (ASTC), so tangent there must be negative: $-1$.
